description: Tika's TSDParserTest.testTSDFileData and testTSDFileDataRecursiveMetadataXML on MANIFEST.XML.TSD. Tika counts three documents (the envelope, a PKCS#7 file and the signed XML in it); here the PKCS#7 content reaches the generic ASN.1 parser, which cannot read its indefinite lengths, so the signed XML is not extracted. That count is not asserted here (tikajs-68os.21). Read from the Tika source, not run against a Tika
